_comment: Pre-existing defects this suite found on the day it was written, accepted so
that CI can gate on NEW breakage instead of being red from birth. This is a
debt ledger, not a mute button: every entry names the defect, why it is
tolerated for now, and what fixing it means. Delete an entry when it is fixed
-- the suite will then guard it.
Matching is by page + substring. Anything not listed here still fails.
